relations.subject: Lothar Ledderose
relations.role: professor of the History of Art of Eastern Asia
relations.evidence: Lothar Ledderose (born 12 July 1942 in Munich) is a German professor of the History of Art of Eastern Asia at the University of Heidelberg.
